title: Flaky Test Casefile
user: Teams using Playwright in CI who need to turn intermittent failures into compact, comparable evidence instead of a pile of reruns and screenshots.
smallest_useful_product: Playwright reporter that packages retries, normalizes timing noise, clusters matching failures, and renders a static casefile.
success_measure: For a seeded flaky test, the reporter clusters 80%+ of failures into the right signature and shortens first diagnosis time by 30% versus raw artifacts.
constraints: Artifacts may include credentials/PII; offer request-header and screenshot masking; work from documented Playwright report APIs.
